databases.name: EOIR Immigration Court Database
databases.description: Every immigration court proceeding since the 1970s: hearings, charges, decisions, judges, representation, bond, appeals
databases.source: DOJ Executive Office for Immigration Review

databases.name: ICE Enforcement Database
databases.description: Individual-level records of ICE arrests, detainers, detentions, removals, encounters, and RCA decisions with linked anonymized IDs

databases.name: FEC Campaign Finance Database
databases.description: Individual donations, PAC contributions, committee expenditures, and independent spending across 12 election cycles (2004-2026)

databases.name: ClinicalTrials.gov Database
databases.description: Every registered clinical trial: protocols, conditions, interventions, outcomes, sponsors, facilities, eligibility, and results from AACT/ClinicalTrials.gov
databases.update_frequency: Monthly (AACT updates daily, we rebuild monthly)

databases.name: CMS Medicare Physician & Other Supplier Database
databases.description: Provider-level Medicare Part B claims: what every physician billed, what Medicare paid, services and beneficiaries per NPI per HCPCS code (CY2013-CY2024)
databases.license: Public domain (HCPCS descriptions include AMA CPT content)

databases.name: CMS Open Payments (Sunshine Act) Database
databases.description: Every disclosed industry payment to physicians, non-physician practitioners, and teaching hospitals: general/research/ownership payments with manufacturer, recipient NPI, amount, and nature, PY2013-2025

databases.name: DOL H-1B & PERM Labor Certification Database
databases.description: Every H-1B/H-1B1/E-3 Labor Condition Application and PERM permanent labor certification disclosed by DOL OFLC: employer, job, SOC code, wages, worksite, case status, FY2015-present
databases.source: DOL Office of Foreign Labor Certification disclosure files

databases.name: IPEDS Database
databases.description: Database covering every U.S. postsecondary institution from 1997 to the 2025-26 provisional release—admissions, enrollment, completions, tuition, financial aid, graduation rates, staffing, and more
databases.maintainer: Ian Nason (build pipeline by Paul Goldsmith-Pinkham)

databases.name: FJC Integrated Database (Federal Courts)
databases.description: Every civil case (1988-present), criminal defendant (FY1970-present) and appeal (1971-present) reported by the federal courts to the Administrative Office, from the Federal Judicial Center's Integrated Database: parties, nature of suit, offenses, dispositions, sentences, dates, judges

databases.name: CBP Border Enforcement Database
databases.description: Individual-level Customs and Border Protection records from Deportation Data Project FOIA releases: Border Patrol apprehensions (FY2008-Dec 2025) and apprehensions with place of birth (FY2000-FY2022), encounters, port-of-entry inadmissibility events (CY2014-Jan 2026), Title 42 expulsions, CBP One appointments

databases.name: U.S. Sentencing Commission Offender Datafiles
databases.description: Every federal defendant sentenced FY2002-FY2025 from the U.S. Sentencing Commission's individual offender datafiles: demographics, offense, guideline range, sentence imposed and departures, with the 22,000-variable fixed-width record reshaped into a sentences table plus long tables per count of conviction, guideline computation, drug type and departure reason
databases.update_frequency: Annual (each fiscal year's datafile, typically spring)

databases.name: Cook County State's Attorney Felony Cases
databases.description: Every felony case received by the Cook County (Chicago) State's Attorney's Office 2011 through 2024-12-30 (the series is closed), charge by charge: intake and felony review, initiation with statute/class/bond, dispositions with judge and court, sentences, and diversion referrals
databases.source: Cook County State's Attorney's Office (county open-data portal)
databases.update_frequency: None (series closed by the SAO on 2024-12-30)

databases.name: Federal Judges Biographical Directory (FJC)
databases.description: Every Article III federal judge since 1789 from the Federal Judicial Center's Biographical Directory: demographics, every appointment with its nomination, confirmation and commission dates, chief-judge and senior-status dates, education, professional career and other federal judicial service
databases.source: Federal Judicial Center (Biographical Directory of Article III Federal Judges)
databases.update_frequency: Continuous at the FJC; rebuilt with each datapond refresh

databases.name: Supreme Court Database (SCDB)
databases.description: Every U.S. Supreme Court decision 1791-present from the Supreme Court Database (Washington University): case-level and justice-level rows with dates, citations, parties, issue, decision direction, disposition, votes and opinions, plus the full code book as a table
databases.source: The Supreme Court Database (Washington University in St. Louis)
